title: AT Conformance Agreement Vector (kind: agreement_vector)
description: Drives an AgreementProtocol implementation deterministically: builds voters, optionally `prove()`s a blob, submits N pre-signed votes via `verify()`, then asserts the `finalize()` outcome.

threshold_rank.description: POA only. Minimum voter rank for a vote to count. Defaults to 0 (any voter counts).

stakes.description: POS only. Map of voter_id -> stake (number). Voters not listed have stake 0.

myself.description: Which voter is the protocol owner (the `myself` parameter). Must match a voters[].id.

originator.description: Voter id of the blob's originator (drives the myself == originator short-circuit in finalize). Use a voter id; harness resolves to that voter's uuid.

uuid.description: Stable string identifier for the blob; harness derives a deterministic UUID5 from it. Use any short slug.

payload.description: Optional UTF-8 string used as the blob's payload (mixed into get_hash). Defaults to the blob.uuid string.

votes.description: Each entry produces an AgreementProof signed by `by` and submits it via verify(blob, proof, (msg, sig)). myself's own vote is NOT auto-cast; include it explicitly when wanted (mirrors the production flow where _process_id signs and _vote_collection submits).

outcome.description: Required. The expected boolean return value of finalize(blob).
